description: Alternatives to one named tool: first the ones Work Insiders names in its write-up (with the reason), then others from the same category. Filterable by MCP, free plan and price.

free_plan.description: Only alternatives with a free plan or free tier.

has_mcp.description: Only alternatives with a first party MCP server.

max_monthly_price.description: Maximum starting price in USD per month. Tools with a free plan count as $0. Per seat prices count one seat, yearly prices are divided by 12, and quote-only or pay-per-use tools are left out.

name: workinsiders_find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to a tool
